```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets) 
library(plotly) 
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)


```


```{r, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
	echo = TRUE,
	warning = FALSE,
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_colour_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```


```{r include=FALSE}
get_all_inspections = function(url) {
  
  all_inspections = vector("list", length = 0)
  
  loop_index = 1
  chunk_size = 50000
  DO_NEXT = TRUE
  
  while (DO_NEXT) {
    message("Getting data, page ", loop_index)
    
    all_inspections[[loop_index]] = 
      GET(url,
          query = list(`$order` = "zipcode",
                       `$limit` = chunk_size,
                       `$offset` = as.integer((loop_index - 1) * chunk_size)
                       )
          ) |>
      content("text") |>
      fromJSON() |>
      as_tibble()
    
    DO_NEXT = dim(all_inspections[[loop_index]])[1] == chunk_size
    loop_index = loop_index + 1
  }
  
  all_inspections
  
}

url = "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/43nn-pn8j.json"

nyc_inspections = 
  get_all_inspections(url) %>%
  bind_rows() |> 
  janitor::clean_names()

nyc_inspections =
  nyc_inspections |> 
    mutate(           #fixing variables
      grade = factor( #transform grade into ordinal factor so it can used in plots
               grade, 
               levels = c("A", "B", "C", "N", "Z"), 
               ordered = TRUE),
        score = as.numeric(score), #transform score into numeric so it can used in plots
        longitude = as.numeric(longitude),#compatible for scatter plot
        latitude = as.numeric(latitude) 
      ) |>
  group_by(camis)|>
        filter(inspection_date == max(inspection_date, na.rm = TRUE)) |> # selecting latest grade
  select(-violation_code) |> #selecting just grade
  distinct(camis, .keep_all = TRUE) #removing duplicates
      

```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Manhattan Restaurant Critical Inspection Statuses

```{r, echo=FALSE}
nyc_inspections|> 
  mutate(inspection_date_only = as.Date(inspection_date)) |> 
  filter(boro == "Manhattan", 
         !is.na(longitude), longitude!=0, !is.na(latitude), latitude!=0, 
         critical_flag != "Not Applicable")|>
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Restaurant:", dba, "\n Latest Inspection Date:", inspection_date_only))|>
 plot_ly( 
    x = ~ longitude, y = ~latitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", 
    color= ~critical_flag,  
    colors = c("#EE1289", "#98F5FF"),
        marker = list(size = 4),
    text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.4) |> 
  layout(
  legend = list(
    title = list(text = "<b>Critical Status</b>")))
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Distribution of Restaurant Inspection Scores by NYC Borough

```{r, echo=FALSE}
nyc_inspections |> 
  filter( boro != 0, !is.na(score))|>
  mutate(boro = fct_reorder(boro, score)) |> 
   plot_ly(y = ~score, color = ~boro, type = "box", colors = "viridis")|> 
  layout(
  legend = list(
    title = list(text = "<b>NYC Borough</b>")))

```


### Number of Inspected Restaurants by NYC Borough and Grade

```{r, echo=FALSE}
nyc_inspections |> 
  filter( boro != 0, !is.na(grade), grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"))|>
  group_by(boro)|>
  count(grade) |> 
  mutate(boro = fct_reorder(boro, n), grade = fct_reorder(grade, n)) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~boro, y = ~n, group = ~grade, color = ~grade, type = "bar", colors = "viridis")|> 
  layout(
         xaxis = list(title = "NYC Borough"),  
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of Inspected Restaurants"),
         legend = list(
    title = list(text = "<b>Inspection Grade</b>")))


```
